description: The minimal non-empty run: exactly one record, at the lowest CARD-NUM key the fixture holds. Between case02's empty dataset and case06's two records this is the narrowest input that still reaches app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl:78 - it shows the loop entered, displayed once and left, which an empty file cannot show and fifty records cannot isolate. WHAT THIS CASE PINS ABOVE ALL ELSE: the unit under test is account.AccountBalanceReaderJob - an Account-named class in the account package - yet CBACT02C reads the CARD file and never touches the account file. :29-33 is SELECT CARDFILE-FILE ASSIGN TO CARDFILE, ORGANIZATION INDEXED, ACCESS MODE SEQUENTIAL, RECORD KEY FD-CARD-NUM, over an FD of FD-CARD-NUM X(16) plus FD-CARD-DATA X(134) = 150, and :45 is COPY CVACT02Y. AAP rule R1 governs - the name comes from the prompt, the behaviour comes from the source - and the divergence is catalogued in the register at AAP 0.8.4. A reviewer who trusts the class name authors the wrong case. THE BOUNDARY: zero-based row 0 is the fixture's first row and also its lowest key, 0500024453765740 - carddata.txt is held in ascending key order with no duplicate, so a sequential walk from the start of the file lands here and nowhere else. case04 pins the opposite end at row 49. The row is seeded from the fixture rather than written inline so that the record's bytes are the authoritative ones and the expected line is that row verbatim; that the displayed line is the row itself and not a re-encoding of the six decoded fields is the property case18 isolates. THE RUN is :70-87 exactly once. :71 displays the start banner. :72 performs 0000-CARDFILE-OPEN, whose OPEN INPUT at :120 reports '00', so :121 takes its first arm and :126-127 CONTINUE. :74-81 then performs UNTIL END-OF-FILE = 'Y': the first READ at :93 lands on the CARDFILE-STATUS = '00' arm at :94 and :78 displays CARD-RECORD - the 01 group item, so the whole 150-byte area including FILLER. The second READ reports '10', :99 moves 16 into APPL-RESULT, :107 finds the 88-level APPL-EOF true and :108 moves 'Y' into END-OF-FILE, so the loop ends without a second display. 9000-CARDFILE-CLOSE reports '00' at :139, :140 SUBTRACT APPL-RESULT FROM APPL-RESULT leaves zero, the end banner follows at :85, and GOBACK at :87 leaves RETURN-CODE 0. In repository terms the sequence is startBrowse '00', then readNext '00' delivering the record, then readNext '10' at end of file, then endBrowse '00' (gate G47). The job is driven at tasklet/step level, with no JobLauncher and no HTTP in the path (gate G51). MESSAGE ARITHMETIC: 1 start banner + 1 record image + 1 end banner = 3 ordered DISPLAY_LINE entries, of 38, 150 and 36 characters. Exactly one image per record, because the DISPLAY inside the read paragraph at :96 is a COMMENT and no 1100-DISPLAY paragraph exists, so :78 is the only live display - one line per record, never CBACT01C's thirteen lines per record nor CBACT03C's two identical ones. RECORD GEOMETRY, taken mechanically from app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy (RECLN 150), one-based and cumulative so a reviewer can check this file against the copybook without running anything: CARD-NUM X(16) at 1-16 and also the RECORD KEY, CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) at 17-27, CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) at 28-30, CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) at 31-80, CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) at 81-90 - carrying the copybook's own misspelling, never corrected - CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) at 91, and FILLER X(59) at 92-150. 16+11+3+50+10+1+59 = 150 (gate G19). This row decomposes to 0500024453765740, then 00000000050, then 747, then 'Aniya Von' followed by 41 spaces, then 2023-03-09, then Y, then 59 spaces - so the image ends in 59 significant spaces which must not be trimmed (gate G21). The copybook declares no COMP-3, no PACKED-DECIMAL and no S9, so every numeric span is unsigned zoned DISPLAY and there is no sign overpunch to model on this path. WIRING: app/jcl/READCARD.jcl:22 is a bare //STEP05 EXEC PGM=CBACT02C and the job declares no PARM anywhere, so jobParameters is empty; its single //CARDFILE DD at :25-26 is the only dataset seeded, addressed by the CARDFILE binding key that application.yml resolves at record length 150 and never by a dataset name, so no DSNAME literal appears in this file (gate G46). ENCODING is US-ASCII, named explicitly rather than left to a platform default. NOTHING IS WRITTEN: expectedWrites and expectedFinalState are empty because :120 opens INPUT and the program contains no WRITE, REWRITE or DELETE - SYSOUT at READCARD.jcl:27 is its only output - and no normalisation is declared, because carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes CVACT02Y declares. PROVENANCE: every expected value here is STATICALLY DERIVED by structured reading of app/cbl/CBACT02C.cbl, cross-checked against app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy for each offset and width, app/jcl/READCARD.jcl for the step and DD contract, and the real app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt for the seeded row. It was NEVER captured from a live COBOL execution: AAP 0.7.6 proves that impossible in this environment with eight independently verified blockers - no z/OS runtime, the available compiler's indexed file handler disabled, subprogram linkage that cannot be made executable, a copybook that will not parse, no Language Environment CEE services, no CICS emulator plus three absent IBM copybooks, EBCDIC fixtures needing binary handling, and no alternative compiler installable - and the substitution is recorded as risk R-A. One record in, three lines out, RETURN-CODE 0.
